summary: An autouse fixture in tests/unit/conftest.py (isolate_from_git_hook_environment) deletes every GIT_* variable before each unit test, so a pre-push hook's GIT_DIR from a linked worktree no longer reaches the security-alerts test's git init or the module's git ls-files. tests/unit/test_git_hook_environment.py reproduces the hook environment against a scratch repository and linked worktree and asserts core.bare stays false; with the fixture disabled it fails on assert 'true' == 'false'. End to end, a real push from a scratch clone's linked worktree passed every pre-push hook and left core.bare false; the same push with the fixture disabled was refused (1 failed, 2044 passed) and set core.bare true, reproducing card 17's incident in scratch. The real repository read core.bare=false throughout. The land gate receives no GIT_DIR from git: hydrostat starts it with its own environment minus FILTER, BENCH_MIN_SUITES and ONLY. All three land-gate commands pass in this worktree: terraform init, make validate (8 of 8 blocking stages) and make test-unit (4260 passed). Spec: specs/1406-hook-git-env-isolation/spec.md.
for_the_board: Remove #21 from cards/goal.json: priority item 2 and the READY list.

The hazard is gone only for branches that contain this landing. The pre-push hook runs the pushing worktree's own tests/unit/conftest.py, so a card worktree cut before the landing still flips core.bare=true on a push. Lift the 'push only from the root checkout' rule for a worktree only after its branch is rebased onto main past this landing.
A push from a card worktree is still refused by check-branch-collision (#22), which is now the next blocker for Dynamos that need CI.

Improve drops filed this run: 3 global (a reboot wipes /tmp scratch; pre-commit's pre-push runs nothing for a push with no new commit; the host hook refuses the hook-skipping git flag even inside quoted text) and 2 local (card worktrees have no .venv; make validate fails lint until terraform init -backend=false runs).

After landing, remove the scratch evidence dir ~/.cache/card21-e2e (a bare remote, a clone with a linked worktree, and the push, validate and test-unit logs). Nothing in it is cited by path from a committed file.
